name: Fatal crashes by county and type: trucks, motorcycles, pedestrians and bicyclists, NHTSA FARS 2019 to 2024
description: Fatal motor-vehicle crashes in every US county, state and the nation for 2019 to 2024, from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration's Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS). One record per county, state and the US: fatal crashes and deaths in the newest year, the crashes that involved a large truck, a motorcycle, a pedestrian or a bicyclist, the pedestrians, bicyclists and motorcyclists killed, alcohol-impaired, speeding and work-zone crashes, rural and urban roads, deaths per 100,000 residents, and every earlier year. Every county-year equals the accident table's own rows, and the counties add up to the state and the state to the nation. 2019 to 2023 are NHTSA's final files; 2024 is its first (annual report) release. The county-by-year table is at /research/fatal-crashes-by-county/data.csv. Counts only.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Fatal crashes by county and type: trucks, motorcycles, pedestrians and bicyclists, NHTSA FARS 2019 to 2024 (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963480

distribution.name: fatal-crashes.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: fatal-crashes.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: fatal-crashes-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in fatal-crashes-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to fatal-crashes.csv on id.

recordSet.name: fatal-crashes
recordSet.description: The records of Fatal crashes by county and type: trucks, motorcycles, pedestrians and bicyclists, NHTSA FARS 2019 to 2024, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: area
field.description: The place: a 5-digit county FIPS code (e.g. 48201), a 2-digit state FIPS code (e.g. 48) or US

field.name: areaName
field.description: The county, state or country name

field.name: areaType
field.description: county, state or us

field.name: year
field.description: The newest FARS year in this record (the other years are under `years` in the JSON and in fatal_crashes_YYYY)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Fatal crashes in that year

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: fatalities
field.description: People who died within 30 days of the crash, in that year

field.name: large_truck_crashes
field.description: Fatal crashes with at least one truck over 10,000 lb GVWR (FARS body types 60-64, 66, 67, 71, 72, 78)

field.name: large_truck_deaths
field.description: People killed in those crashes (anyone: truck occupants, other drivers, pedestrians)

field.name: motorcycle_crashes
field.description: Fatal crashes with at least one motorcycle, moped, scooter or three-wheeler (body types 80-89)

field.name: motorcyclist_deaths
field.description: Drivers and passengers killed on those vehicles

field.name: pedestrian_crashes
field.description: Fatal crashes with at least one pedestrian

field.name: pedestrian_deaths
field.description: Pedestrians killed

field.name: bicyclist_crashes
field.description: Fatal crashes with at least one bicyclist

field.name: bicyclist_deaths
field.description: Bicyclists killed

field.name: alcohol_impaired_crashes
field.description: Fatal crashes with a driver at 0.08 BAC or more, from NHTSA's 10 multiple-imputation draws (MIDRVACC), rounded

field.name: alcohol_impaired_deaths
field.description: People killed in those crashes, same method, rounded

field.name: speeding_crashes
field.description: Fatal crashes with a vehicle coded speeding-related (SPEEDREL 1 to 5)

field.name: work_zone_crashes
field.description: Fatal crashes in a work zone (WRK_ZONE 1 to 4)

field.name: rural_crashes
field.description: Fatal crashes on a rural road (RUR_URB 1)

field.name: urban_crashes
field.description: Fatal crashes on an urban road (RUR_URB 2); roads of another or unknown setting are in neither column

field.name: file_status
field.description: final or annual report file (NHTSA's first release of a year, which can change)

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: note
field.description: Caveats

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
